cases.rationale: One fixed import. This module also reads the incoming text used by its callers.
Incoming HTTP text returned by a project helper controls dynamic module choice.
cases.source:
from flask import Flask
from importlib import import_module as load_view
from ui_text import supplied_text
app = Flask(__name__)
@app.route("/channel")
def channel():
    return load_view(supplied_text()).__name__

cases.rationale: A request selects between two literal module choices.
Options supplied by the request are split and appended without an option terminator before a process call.
All split terms reach the process after a fixed option terminator.
Only fixed local text is split into process arguments.
An imported alias receives the string read from the inbound request.
Remote label reader; dynamic module usage in this file only uses a literal.
Either a fixed label or metadata from a remote feed can reach this module loader.
An arbitrary string can affect logging, while the dynamic load always receives a literal.
Remote feed text becomes multiple unguarded arguments of a process via a helper call.
